# AI Infrastructure Intelligence Brief — prepared for Crusoe

*November 4, 2026*

## Top 3 developments

**1.**
- **What happened:** Bloomberg reports CoreWeave bonds hit new lows as Texas data centers come under political scrutiny. Related coverage says 'neocloud' stocks fell as a blue wave raised the prospect of more data center scrutiny.
- **Why it matters to Crusoe:** Crusoe's Abilene, TX campuses for Oracle (1.2 GW) and Microsoft (900 MW), plus its two other Texas campuses, sit in the jurisdiction now under scrutiny. Weaker neocloud credit could also raise financing costs or dampen appetite for the reported Crusoe IPO. Watch whether Texas officials propose concrete data center restrictions and whether neocloud bond prices keep falling.
- **Confidence:** Reported
- **Source:** [CoreWeave Bonds Hit New Lows as Texas Data Centers in Crosshairs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQVlEyOVh1N1ZONVgyWXFubUw5djZvMmxxTGVSMVE5MHJxY2x3aU81UTZLSklRYVptNVdrWVo1aUJqMUtzM0YtLXl1cjJUSUJvdGFVQ0hoWTE2dXBsT3JoT1dYYUhLUm9kSlEyUDBNRmlsV1NvSzhUNHdLV21jRVdJRFotS2lVOUJFWFhDcl91QXJzeDlITlhHb1RuZjVZMGw4dVdSSF8tYWJFeEF2bGZUZElUeXZUZw?oc=5) (Bloomberg.com)

**2.**
- **What happened:** Anti-data center ballot measures are reportedly on track to pass 40-1, which the Washington Examiner calls a sign of backlash.
- **Why it matters to Crusoe:** Local votes like these could constrain siting for Crusoe's 40+ GW pipeline and its Missouri and Texas expansions, because projects need local approval to proceed. Watch the certified results and whether any passed measures cover jurisdictions in Crusoe's pipeline.
- **Confidence:** Reported
- **Source:** [Anti-data center ballot measures on track to go 40-1 in sign of backlash](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPclBuN0NiQXc3cmNkM3FOUE03LWszWXppUG44NDB2aFU0VU54MjEyem9EaWZSRXhMUzdWUnBzTTNxbTRDYUxMemVVbGkyTGZFWnRjZEJrakVsbjhOaDdfZmlyRXdWN2lqbXhYVEo1QmFFcXlrelYxcmhuak1RamNxNzBnQWFlcktLNVRXMDF1WE8zZF83aElWRU9KWUtuM19SWEMxSmMyZ0ZMSnU0WE9BVDBvRWFra2VfcXc?oc=5) (Washington Examiner)

**3.**
- **What happened:** Nvidia has reportedly told data center partners to cut their China exposure and is limiting RTX chip sales to mainland China, as the US and China look to decouple.
- **Why it matters to Crusoe:** Crusoe Cloud runs on Nvidia GPUs, so partner conditions tied to China exposure could reach Crusoe through its supply relationship. The link is indirect unless Crusoe has China-linked customers or suppliers. Watch whether Nvidia makes these partner requirements formal and how they define 'exposure'.
- **Confidence:** Reported
- **Source:** [Nvidia tells data center partners to cut China exposure, limits RTX chip sales to mainland](https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/nvidia-tells-data-center-partners-to-cut-china-exposure-limits-rtx-chip-sales-to-mainland/) (Data Center Dynamics)
